purpose: Counterevidence against claiming that ordinary child exit necessarily causes killpg ESRCH
method: Launch one harmless Python child running os._exit(0), start_new_session=True; wait 0.1 seconds without reaping; read /proc/PID/stat; perform killpg(PID,0) (no signal delivered); reap with wait().
interpretation: The fake ESRCH result proves exception handling behavior only. A natural process-group disappearance race in this single-threaded supervisor has not been established and is excluded from confirmed findings.
safety: No model, GPU, service, guard, monitor, IPMI command, or external notification was used. Signal 0 performs existence/permission checking only.
